points.description: States that the data rate (output of the compressor) must not exceed the channel capacity of the communication channel.
States that the full capacity of the communication channel should be utilized (no unused channel capacity/bandwidth).
States that maximum (reconstruction) quality of the data must be preserved/maximized.

rubric.notes: All three issues are required: data rate not exceeding channel capacity, full utilization of channel capacity, and maximum quality preserved. Award each point only if stated precisely with the channel capacity/data rate/quality terms; vague statements such as "efficient compression" earn nothing. Total marks round to 2 only for all three; two correct points give 1 mark, one gives 0. A wrong extra item (e.g. claiming lossless is mandatory or unrelated issues like power cost) costs a point.
